opening.argument: The speaker presents recurring Bitcoin income as dependent on team growth and weaker-leg balances, while directing viewers to fund a wallet with at least $100. He instructs them to recruit two people, one on each side, for weekly binary bonuses, and describes payments tied to recruits' starting amounts. A presentation further connects higher monetary levels with compensation deeper in the binary structure. The pitch raises earnings of “15 K a week,” invokes 5,000-member social proof, imposes a seven-day sign-up consequence, and directs viewers to a link, all to encourage participation. These features establish a recruitment-based, tiered opportunity, although the records do not establish actual payments, losses, or whether the system operates as presented.
